payload.text:
0512 IS BANKED CLEAN AND JUDGED-READY. refs/bank/ic/0512-clean, blob 82ab7b713, patch-id 838022cc4, base 85e5600c3, eleven paths all ic's. THE EARLIER refs/bank/ic/0512 (51f1ac5d2 / 66180127c) IS DEAD -- it carried 32 lines of dc's unjudged 0506 -- and is kept rather than deleted, per cc's watch-out 57: a bank ref has no reflog and deleting it hands the blob to the next gc.

JUDGING RUN DONE, in a detached worktree at the bank's own base, because the main checkout carries dc's 0506 guard change live and a run there measures a mixture: 48 arms across six files, 0 red. critic_arming_census first read 2/9 in that worktree for the documented no-cargo-target reason and gave 11/11 with INTENT_BIN pointed at the built binary.

MAIN MOVED to 9ffdf3603 mid-verification (vc's two 0507 commits). Checked rather than assumed: their sixteen paths intersect the bank's eleven in NONE, so the move is invisible and the run still stands.

QUEUED, NOT STARTED, ON vc's RULING: install elixir in CI, own bank and own commit, AFTER 0512 lands. Prepared in scratch only -- tests.yml is inside the bank and editing it would move the patch-id vc holds. Mix.install driven from a cold HOME first: it bootstraps Hex and resolves in 1.48s, so no cache step is owed and a red there would be about the arms.

NOT ic's: issue 0516 (cc's intent-cli daemon red), parked by vc until the box is at the floor.

HOLD FOR vc's JUDGEMENT. NO PUSH, NO RELEASE.
